Seat rulings on the pre-claim report (`/mnt/project-files/card-36544/pre-claim-report-0e361201.md`, main 0e361201):
- Scope: `form.modalSize` only. It is retired by a `retiredKey()` tombstone at major 19, the route of the `knowledge-source-inert-keys-removed` precedent, following the `spec-property-retirement` skill.
- `form.subforms` is out of this card. It is declared but has no reader, and ADR-0035 and ADR-0050 §3 name it as a live layer, so retiring or implementing it is the maintainer's call. The seat files a decision card from this thread's draft.
- The hotcrm uses (6 under the default internal `form:`) are not touched here. After merge the seat adds them to hotcrm#2840, the same spec 19 port.
File surface:
- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (:5703): the tombstone, with guidance on the effective mechanism (the host sizes its own modal; the React `ObjectForm` block takes its own `modalSize`).
- `packages/spec/src/…/react-blocks.ts` (:253): `dataProps` moves `modalSize` into the block's overlay, as #29012 did for drawerSide/drawerWidth. This regenerates `skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md`.
- `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` `form.modalSize` and `liveness/form.json` `modalSize`: `dead` with a REMOVED note. The README counts are recomputed.
- The conversion `entries/19/form-view-modal-size-removed.ts` with `MAJOR_19_CONVERSIONS`, the retired-keys entry with `gen:migration-registry`, `registry.ts.template` step 19, and one D3 semantic entry.
- The 18 conversion fixtures that use `modalSize` as a bystander key (`form-view-drawer-keys-removed.ts` :94/:128, `form-view-presentation-types-removed.ts` :213/:267) switch to another live key.
- Pins: `form-view-drawer-keys-retirement.test.ts` CONTROL cases and `form-view-type-layout-retirement.test.ts` :231 become a refusal-with-prescription pin, plus a tree-scoped absence pin inside the `CROSS_PACKAGE_TEST_INPUTS` radius.
- Generated: `gen:schema`, `gen:api-surface`, `gen:docs`. The whole `check:generated` group runs.
- Prose that tells `rule-explanations.ts` :5225 and the plugin-form docs about the block property is read and kept where it is right.
- One `.changeset/*.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, a BREAKING banner, FROM → TO, and the ADR-0087 disposition marker.
Stop on breach and explain in the report.
Container & model: `M`, `mode:thread`, `model: claude-fable-5-2 (Model tier — MANDATORY: claude-fable-5-2 — skills/objectstack-ui/references/react-blocks.md ⇢ 'skills/**', a generated file in the surface, no one-line exemption)`, `effort: high`, reason: a narrowing retirement across fourteen surfaces, with generated outputs; the thread switches to the mandated model before the first edit
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Responsibility: an author who writes `modalSize` on a form view is refused at parse with the tombstone's guidance. The key never decided anything since #36425, so no stack loses behaviour. `os migrate meta --from 18 --write` strips it. The PR title carries `!`, it owes a `Skills-docs:` line, the contract-review L2 and a dogfood battery on the landing head, and it lands through the maintainer (Tier H, skills/** in the diff).
Thread-read: 7193096338
Premise: holds, measured on origin/main 0e361201 (call graph closed; zero authoring in examples/apps, hotcrm only under the inert default form)
Serial constraints cleared: `#37924 also edits packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts (another conversion). Merge main after #37924 lands, before the PR leaves draft, and order the entry by the header comment.`

repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Claim amendment (file surface), for claim 7233564954 (amended 7233624584), at WIP 3ae879ff. The seat accepts three additions:
- `ui/Form:modalSize` also goes from live to retired, because the `form` entry takes FormView's shape by reference and the authorable surface lists it on its own row. So there are two retired-keys files (`ui/FormView` and `ui/Form`), and the conversion also walks `forms[]`.
- `shared/retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`: one JOIN row, following the #29287 precedent.
- `18.ui-form-view-type-layout-only.ts`: the D3 replacement no longer says the console dialogs are "sized by `modalSize`" and now says they "choose their own size". This is prose in the same package, and the changeset says so.
Declined: the `ui/packages/types/src/objectql.ts` key-class comment stays as it is. That keeps `ui/` and an `@object-ui/types` patch out of this narrowing PR. Note it in the Acceptance notes.
Everything else in the claim stands.
